home.hero_tag: New · photo analysis of African dishes
home.hero_lead: Snap your plate: Omeo recognizes the dish, estimates portions and tells you where you stand. Ndolé, thieboudienne, attiéké… we know them.
home.hero_note: Free · 3 days of Plus included · 7 with an invite code
home.phone_alt: Omeo app home screen: 890 kcal left, today's protein, carbs and fat
home.tile1_body: The dish, the ingredients and the portions, recognized in seconds.
home.tile2_body: Adjust quantities in one gesture. Values come from our database, not a random guess.
home.tile3_body: Your daily log: 4 meals, water, and the essentials at a glance.
home.tile4_body: Calories, carbs, fat, protein, fiber and salt, in simple charts.
home.tile5_body: Steps and workouts imported automatically. Video exercises and guided sessions.
home.tile6_body: Journeys of a few weeks, 7 to 30-day challenges, badges to earn.
home.sport_title: What you eat, against what you <accent>burn.</accent>
home.sport_lead: Your steps, workouts and calories burned come in on their own from Health Connect or Apple Health. Omeo calculates your balance and adjusts your goal on active days.
home.sport_item1: Steps and distance, without typing anything
home.sport_item2: Workouts imported with their heart rate
home.sport_item3: Video exercises, subtitled in your language
home.balance_chart: Calories eaten and burned over the last 7 days
home.balance_note: Omeo reads your data and never writes anything. Only daily totals leave your phone.
home.content_lead: Recipes created by our team with their nutrition calculated. Plant guides: traditional uses, benefits, precautions.
home.pricing_title: Free to start. <accent>Plus</accent> to go further.
home.quotes_title: They say it <accent>better than we do.</accent>
home.quote1: “I thought apps didn't know ndolé. Omeo does. And I barely type anything anymore.”
home.quote2: “In 2 months I cut my salt in half. The tips are simple and talk about what I actually cook.”
home.quote3: “The 8,000 steps challenge got me moving again. The phone counts everything on its own.”
home.final_title: Your next meal could be <accent>the first.</accent>

features.title: Less typing. <accent>More clarity.</accent>
features.photo_body: Take a photo of your dish. Omeo recognizes it, lists the ingredients and estimates portions. Nutrition values come from our food database, built with local names.
features.photo_item1: West and Central African dishes, then the world's
features.photo_item2: Correct ingredients and quantities in one gesture
features.photo_item3: Voice or text entry: “a ndolé with two plantains” (Plus)
features.tracking_body: Calories left, protein, carbs, fat, fiber and salt. A daily log with your 4 meals and your hydration.
features.tracking_item1: Goals calculated for you, recalculated at each weigh-in
features.tracking_item2: 7-day charts, up to 1 year with Plus
features.tracking_item3: Weight tracking with your target and trend
features.sport_body: Steps, distance, calories and workouts come in on their own from Health Connect or Apple Health. Omeo calculates your balance and adjusts your goal on active days.
features.sport_item1: Read-only: Omeo never writes to your health data
features.sport_item2: Video exercises, subtitled in your language
features.sport_item4: Manual entry when nothing is imported
features.programs_body: Programs of a few weeks (lose weight, build muscle, prevent diabetes…) and 7 to 30-day challenges, validated automatically.
features.programs_item1: Suggested meals, workout and tip of the day
features.programs_item2: Challenges: 8,000 steps, 2 L of water, balanced plate…
features.programs_item4: No leaderboard: you go at your own pace
features.content_body: Recipes created by our team with their nutrition calculated, and plant guides: traditional uses, benefits and precautions.
features.content_item1: Filters by country, goal and time
features.content_item2: “Add to my meal” in one gesture
features.content_item4: Prevention tips adapted to your data
features.cta_lead: Free, with 3 days of Plus included.
